column1: # Re-scoring worksheet for the R/P/I re-anchoring of docs/agents/DISPATCH.md 1.
# Pin: open issues read 2026-08-28 with `gh issue list --state open --limit 200`,
# `header` is the issue's Dispatch: line VERBATIM, so the before-scores are not a
# transcription anyone has to trust -- scripts/dispatch_rescore.py parses them out of
# it. What is NOT machine-checkable here is whether the header still says this on
# GitHub today: no CI job has network. Re-read the issues before quoting these.
# V and S are HELD AT THEIR HEADER VALUES on purpose. This branch re-anchors R, P
# and I only, and holding the other two isolates the effect. The harness enforces it.
# Sample: 24 drawn by a deterministic stratified rule (sort each current band by
# issue number ascending; take every 1st of Routine and Critical, every 4th of
# Standard, every 5th of Heavy), plus 4 chosen deliberately -- marked `supplementary`
# -- to reach cells the stratified draw missed (P=3 documentation work, and the two
# worked examples in 4 that are still open).
#   issue  stratum  header  R_after V_after S_after P_after I_after  whyR  whyP  whyI
